# cs-stats.com — Challenger Series Table Tennis Statistics

> Advanced statistics platform for the Challenger Series table tennis league in Germany.
> Independent fan project, not affiliated with Challenger Series.

## What this site covers

- Player profiles: win/loss records, win rates, total earnings, deuce records, comeback rates
- Head-to-head records between all active players
- Tournament results and champion history (2024–2026)
- Attendance data per session and venue
- 190+ active players across 150+ tournaments

## Data source

Results are automatically parsed from official PDF scoresheets published by challengerseries.net after each tournament weekend. Data is updated within 24 hours of publication.

## Key pages

- /players — full player directory sortable by wins, win rate, earnings, deuce performance
- /players/[slug] — individual player profile with full stats and match history
- /h2h — head-to-head match explorer between any two players
- /stats — advanced cross-player statistics and leaderboards
- /attendance — venue and session attendance data
- /faq — guide explaining all statistics and user profiles (bettor, agent, athlete/coach)

## Statistics explained

- Win Rate: wins / total matches (min. 20 matches for leaderboard)
- Deuce Win Rate: sets won in deuce (10-10) / total deuce sets
- Comeback Rate: matches won after losing first set / total such opportunities
- Tournament Wins: number of tournament titles
